type_analyst_note.reading: Keep the computed type as the base lens but flag a hybrid: a mature software/license-support compounder plus a capital-intensive AI-infrastructure scale-up (OCI). FY2026 revenue 67.4B (+17.3%), GAAP operating margin 30.6% (FY2021 37.6%, down 7.0pp), OCF 32.0B vs capex 55.7B (FCF about -23.7B); FY2025 capex 21.2B vs OCF 20.8B; Q1 FY27 revenue +30%, IaaS +121%, RPO $664B. Questions this type adds: funding of the build-out (debt $125B, mandatory convertible, ATM program -> holder dilution), RPO conversion and counterparty concentration, return on incremental capital of OCI, cyclicality of AI capex demand. The type chooses questions/KPIs only, never a number.
